question: Is our 30-day evaluation cycle stricter than Part 2.2 requires?
answer: No. The material does not support the claim that a 30-day cycle is stricter than Part 2.2. Section [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec] states that at least once every 35 calendar days, security patches must be evaluated. Section [csection-285d8c24551776cb380d] confirms this 35-day requirement. Section [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3] explains that the operator's 30-day cycle is intentional and not a gap, meaning it is stricter than the 35-day minimum.
